title: Business Renewal
body: Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo Pagbabago ng Business Permit I-renew ang iyong business permit sa BPLO sa Mapandan. Taunang renewal para sa compliance. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Pagbabago ng Business Permit", "description": "Ang mga negosyo na nag-operate sa loob ng Mapandan ay kinakailangang mag-renew ng kanilang business permit taun-taon.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Businesses operating within Mapandan are required to renew their business permits annually. Renewal ensures that your business remains compliant with local regulations and avoids penalties for late filing. Mga Kinakailangan Filled up UNIFIED Form / Community Tax Certificate (from BPLO/Treasury Office) DTI/SEC/CDA Registration (from DTI/SEC/CDA Office or Online Application) BIR COR (from RDO Calasiao) Barangay Clearance (System Integrated) Prosedura Fill up the UNIFIED form and submit necessary requirements for verification (10 min). BPLO encodes data into the e-BPLS System. BPLO endorses applicant to Engineering, MPDC, RHU, and BFP for required certificates (44 min). Pay fees at the Treasury Office. Fees include Mayor's Permit, Business Tax (% of Gross Sales), Plate & Sticker, Weights & Measure, Storage Fee, and Garbage Fee. Proceed to the Mayor's Office for issuance of renewed Business Permit. Claim business plate and sticker at the Treasury Office. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: ~1 hour (similar to new business permit process) Bayad: Mayor's Permit (₱500–₱1,000) + Business Tax (% of Gross Sales) + Business Plate & Sticker (₱250) + Weights & Measure (₱100–200) + Storage Fee (₱550) + Garbage Fee (₱800–₱1,200) Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Cedula
body: Real Property at Revenue Cedula / Community Tax Certificate Kumuha ng iyong Community Tax Certificate (cedula) sa Mapandan. Individual: ₱5 + ₱1/₱1k; Juridical: ₱500 + ₱2/₱5k. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Cedula / Community Tax Certificate", "description": "Ang Community Tax Certificate (cedula) ay kinakailangan para sa iba't ibang transaksyon sa pamahalaan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Community Tax Certificate (cedula) is computed as follows: Individual — ₱5.00 basic + ₱1.00 for every ₱1,000 gross income from business, profession, or property, but in no case shall exceed ₱5,000.00. Juridical — ₱500.00 basic + ₱2.00 for every ₱5,000 gross income from business or worth of real property, but in no case shall exceed ₱10,000.00. Interest of 24% per annum shall be imposed on individual or juridical securing their CTC from March 1 up to the end of the year. Mga Kinakailangan Old Community Tax Certificate (if available) Proof of income (if available) Prosedura Go to Counters 1 and 2 and fill up the basic data form (15 min). Pay the required fees (3 min). Receive community tax certificate. Staff records in general collection system (2 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Treasury Office (MTO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 20 minutes (15 min form filling + 3 min payment + 2 min recording) Bayad: Individual: ₱5 + ₱1/₱1k income (max ₱5,000); Juridical: ₱500 + ₱2/₱5k income (max ₱10,000); 24% interest from March 1 Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Health Consultation
body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan Konsultasyong Pangkalusugan Libreng konsultasyong pangkalusugan sa Mapandan RHU. Walk-in service para sa lahat ng residente. 25 minuto bawat kliyente. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Konsultasyong Pangkalusugan", "description": "Nag-aalok ang Municipal Health Office / Rural Health Unit ng libreng serbisyo ng konsultasyong pangkalusugan sa lahat ng residente ng Mapandan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Municipal Health Office (MHO) / Rural Health Unit (RHU) provides free health consultation services to all residents of Mapandan. This includes general medical consultations, health advice, and referrals to higher-level health facilities when necessary. Walk-in patients are served on a first-come, first-served basis. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Prosedura Register in Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Midwife registers new patients and encodes data. Classify patient: PhilHealth member (attach ID number) or non-PhilHealth member. Record consultation date, vital signs, and chief complaint. Occupy seats in waiting area and wait for name to be called. MHO check-up, assess, and treat the patient. Schedule follow-up check-up. Give available medicines to patient and encode. title: Land Transfer
body: Real Property at Revenue Paglilipat ng Ownership ng Lupa Maglipat ng ownership ng lupa sa Mapandan sa Assessor's Office. ₱150 recording fee, 30 minuto para sa Assessor processing. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Paglilipat ng Ownership ng Lupa", "description": "Ang paglilipat ng ownership ng lupa ay legal na proseso ng paglilipat ng mga karapatan sa ari-arian mula sa isang may-ari patungo sa isa pa.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Transfer of land ownership is the legal process of transferring property rights from one owner to another. The Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) records the transfer and updates the Tax Declaration under the new owner's name. The client first secures a tax clearance from the Treasury Office, then submits the transfer documents to the Assessor's Office. The Assessor records the transaction, cancels the old Tax Declaration, and issues a new one. Fee: ₱150 for recording. Mga Kinakailangan Deed of Sale, Deed of Donation, or other proof of transfer Tax Clearance from the Municipal Treasurer's Office Certified True Copy of Tax Declaration (from Assessor's Office) Valid Government-issued ID of the new owner BIR Certificate of Registration (if applicable) Prosedura Secure a Tax Clearance from the Municipal Treasurer's Office. Obtain a Certified True Copy of the Tax Declaration from the Assessor's Office. Submit all required documents to the Assessor's Office. Assessor reviews and records the transfer (15 min). Assessor cancels the old Tax Declaration and prepares the new one (10 min). Pay ₱150 recording fee at the Treasury Office. Claim the new Tax Declaration under the new owner's name (5 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) Klasipikasyon: Complex Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 30 minutes (Assessor recording); full transfer may take 15–30 working days Bayad: ₱150 (recording fee at Assessor's Office) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 633-2653 / 0945-114-2515 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. Kabilang ang 10-day publication period.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Civil Registry at mga Vital Record", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A marriage license is a legal requirement before a marriage can be solemnized in the Philippines. title: Name Correction
body: Civil Registry at mga Vital Record Pagwawasto ng Pangalan (RA 9048) Iwasto ang iyong birth certificate sa ilalim ng RA 9048. ₱3,000 para sa pagbabago ng pangalan, ₱1,000 para sa clerical error. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Pagwawasto ng Pangalan (RA 9048)", "description": "Ang RA 9048 ay nagpapahintulot sa pagwawasto ng mga clerical o typographical error.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Civil Registry at mga Vital Record", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Republic Act No. 9048 authorizes the city or municipal civil registrar to correct clerical or typographical errors in civil registry entries without the need for a judicial order. This covers corrections in first names, nicknames, or minor spelling errors. This process does not apply to changes in gender, date of birth, or other substantive entries. Mga Kinakailangan Proof of Publication (from PSA) Certificate of Live Birth (from PSA) NBI Clearance Police Clearance (from PNP) Certificate of Employment (if employed) / Affidavit of non-employment Marriage Certificate, Medical records, SSS records, land title, baptismal certificate Prosedura Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office and submit all required documents. File the petition for correction of clerical error. Pay the required fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Wait for the publication period to be completed. After publication and verification, claim the corrected birth certificate from the MCR. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) Klasipikasyon: Complex Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 10-day posting + 5 days MCR decision + 2–3 months PSA processing Bayad: ₱3,000 (change of first name) / ₱1,000 (correction of clerical error) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 633-2487 / 0912-115-5000 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Rpt Payment
body: Real Property at Revenue Bayad sa Real Property Tax Magbayad ng iyong real property tax sa Mapandan. Basic 1% + SEF 1% ng assessed value. 10%–20% diskwento para sa prompt/advance payment. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Bayad sa Real Property Tax", "description": "Ang real property tax (RPT) ay taunang buwis sa assessed value ng lupa, mga gusali, at mga pagpapabuti.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Real property tax (RPT) is an annual tax on the assessed value of land, buildings, and improvements within Mapandan. Computation: Basic Tax = 1% of Assessed Value + Special Education Tax (SEF) = 1% of Assessed Value. Discounts: 10% for prompt payment, 20% for advance payment. Interest on unpaid real property tax: 2% per month but not to exceed 72%. Payment is processed at Counters 4-9 of the Treasury Office. Mga Kinakailangan Real Property Tax bill (from Assessor's Office) Previous Tax receipt (if available) Prosedura Go to Counters 4 to 9 and request computation of real property tax. Staff computes the real property tax due (20 min). Pay the required fees (5 min). Receive the official receipt. Staff records in general collection system (5 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Treasury Office (MTO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 30 minutes (20 min computation + 5 min payment + 5 min recording) Bayad: Basic Tax (1% of AV) + SEF (1% of AV); 10% prompt payment discount; 20% advance payment discount Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter / Provincial Ordinance No. 253-2020 Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Sanitary Permit
body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan Sanitary Permit Kumuha ng sanitary permit, health certificate, o medical certificate sa Mapandan RHU. 53 minuto ang oras ng pagproseso. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Sanitary Permit", "description": "Ang sanitary permit ay kinakailangan para sa lahat ng negosyo na humawak ng pagkain, inumin, o iba pang consumable na produkto.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A sanitary permit is required for all businesses that handle food, beverages, or other consumable products to ensure compliance with health and sanitation standards. The permit is issued by the Municipal Health Office (MHO) after an inspection of the business premises to verify that health and safety regulations are met. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Laboratory Tests: CBC, urinalysis, fecalysis, sputum exam, Hepatitis B (from RHU Primary Laboratory) Chest X-Ray, PA (from government or private diagnostic facility) Prosedura Present official receipt from the Treasury Office. Laboratory examination of urine, feces, sputum is conducted by Medical Technologist (30 min). Refer to other laboratories for X-ray if needed (2 min). Refer result to MHO for interpretation (10 min). MHO does physical examination and interprets result (5 min). MHO prescribes medicines if needed (2 min). MHO signs the certification (2 min). List down certificate number on logbook and release certification (2 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Rural Health Unit (RHU) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 53 minutes per client Bayad: ₱130 (laboratory tests) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Health Office, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1874 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Senior Pwd Id
body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon Senior Citizen / PWD ID Mag-apply para sa Senior Citizen o Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Senior Citizen / PWD ID", "description": "Ang Senior Citizen ID at Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID ay mga ID na inilalabas ng pamahalaan na nagbibigay ng mga benepisyo at pribilehiyo sa mga tagadala.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Senior Citizen ID and Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID are government-issued identification cards that provide holders with benefits and privileges under the law. Senior Citizens (60 years old and above) and PWDs are entitled to discounts, tax exemptions, and other benefits as mandated by RA 9994 (Senior Citizens Act) and RA 7277 (Magna Carta for Disabled Persons). The IDs are processed through the MSWDO and MCR in coordination with the national implementing agencies. Mga Kinakailangan Birth certificate or PSA-issued document as proof of age (for Senior Citizens) Barangay certification of residency Two (2) pieces of 2x2 ID photos Medical certificate (for PWD applicants, indicating the nature of disability) Prosedura Secure a barangay certification of residency from your barangay office. For PWD applicants, obtain a medical certificate indicating the nature and severity of the disability. Submit all required documents to the MSWDO or MCR office. Wait for verification and processing of your application. Receive your Senior Citizen or PWD ID upon approval. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: MSWDO + MCR Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 3–5 working days Bayad: Free Saan Mag-aapply: MSWDO Office, Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1751 / 0930-641-3934 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Special Event Permit
body: Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo Special Event Permit Kumuha ng permit para sa mga espesyal na kaganapan tulad ng mga festival, konsert, fair, at iba pang pampublikong pagtitipon sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Special Event Permit", "description": "Ang special event permit ay kinakailangan para sa mga indibidwal o organisasyon na nagpaplanong maghos ng mga pampublikong kaganapan sa loob ng Mapandan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A special event permit is required for individuals or organizations planning to hold public events within Mapandan. This includes festivals, concerts, trade fairs, sports tournaments, and other gatherings that may affect public roads, spaces, or safety. Mga Kinakailangan Event proposal with detailed description, expected attendance, and schedule Sketch or map of the event venue Safety and security plan Event insurance (if applicable, depending on event type and size) Barangay endorsement from the barangay where the event will be held Prosedura Secure a barangay endorsement from the barangay where the event will take place. Prepare the event proposal, venue sketch, and safety plan. Submit all requirements to the Municipal Treasurer’s Office (MTO) and/or Mayor’s Office. Wait for review and approval; pay any required fees. Receive the approved special event permit. title: Tax Declaration
body: Real Property at Revenue Kopya ng Tax Declaration Humiling ng kopya ng iyong tax declaration mula sa Municipal Assessor's Office sa Mapandan. ₱100 bawat certified true copy, 15 minuto ang pagproseso. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Kopya ng Tax Declaration", "description": "Ang tax declaration ay opisyal na dokumento na nagpapakita ng assessed value ng iyong real property para sa layunin ng buwis.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A tax declaration is an official document that shows the assessed value of your real property for taxation purposes. The Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) of Mapandan issues certified true copies of Tax Declarations upon request. This document is required for property sales, loans, insurance applications, tax payments, and other legal transactions. The client submits a written request with property details and the Assessor's Office locates the record, prepares the certified true copy, and releases it upon payment. Mga Kinakailangan Written request stating the property location (lot number, block, street, barangay) Valid Government-issued ID Prosedura Submit a written request with property details and valid ID to the Assessor's Office. Staff receives and verifies the request (5 min). Staff locates the Tax Declaration in the records (5 min). Staff prepares the certified true copy and stamps it (3 min). Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office and claim the document (2 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 15 minutes Bayad: ₱100 per certified true copy Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 633-2653 / 0945-114-2515 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Zoning Clearance
body: Gusali, Engineering, at Zoning Zoning Clearance Kumuha ng zoning clearance bago magtayo, mag-renovation, o magbago ng paggamit ng isang ari-arian sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Zoning Clearance", "description": "Ang zoning clearance ay nagpapatunay na ang ibinigay na paggamit o konstruksyon sa isang ari-arian ay sumusunod sa land use plan at zoning regulation ng bayan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Gusali, Engineering, at Zoning", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A zoning clearance certifies that the intended use or construction on a property complies with the municipality’s land use plan and zoning regulations. It is a prerequisite for obtaining a building permit or for any change in land use classification. Mga Kinakailangan Certificate of land title or ownership documents (e.g., Tax Declaration, Deed of Sale) Site development plan or proposed layout Sketch of property location (showing the lot in relation to nearby streets/landmarks) Prosedura Visit the Municipal Planning and Development Office (MPDC) or Zoning Office. Submit the required documents along with the zoning clearance application form. Pay the applicable fee at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Receive the zoning clearance after verification of land use compliance. title: Certificate Of Indigency
body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon Certipiko ng Indigency Kumuha ng Certificate of Indigency mula sa MSWDO para sa mga diskwento sa ospital, tulong sa legal, mga scholarship, at iba pang serbisyong panlipunan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Certipiko ng Indigency", "description": "Ang Certificate of Indigency ay inilalabas sa mga indigent na pamilya na sertipikado ng Barangay Captain.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Certificate of Indigency is issued by the MSWDO to indigent families certified by the Barangay Captain. This document is required to avail of various services including hospital discounts, legal assistance from the Public Attorney's Office (PAO), scholarship assistance for college education, and other social welfare programs. The MSWDO conducts an interview and assessment to verify the client's eligibility before issuing the certificate. Mga Kinakailangan Barangay Certificate of Indigency Medical Certificate (if hospitalized) Police report / Police blotter / RTC/MTC report (if applicable) Report Card Form 138 / Recommendation (if for students) Birth Certificate (PSA/MCR) Prosedura Register at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer you and conduct an initial interview. Submit your Barangay Certificate of Indigency and other supporting documents. Staff will conduct an interview and assess your eligibility for assistance. Receive your Certificate of Indigency upon approval. title: Solo Parent Id
body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon Solo Parent ID Mag-apply para sa Solo Parent ID sa Mapandan. Alamin ang mga kinakailangan, eligibility, at proseso ng assessment sa MSWDO. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Solo Parent ID", "description": "Ang Solo Parent ID ay inilalabas sa mga solo parent ayon sa RA 8972 (Solo Parents' Welfare Act of 2000).", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Solo Parent ID is issued by the MSWDO to qualifying solo parents as mandated by RA 8972 (Solo Parents' Welfare Act of 2000). Holders are entitled to benefits including flexible work arrangements, educational assistance for children, and health care privileges. The MSWDO assesses eligibility using the solo parent intake form. Processing includes a 6-month assessment period before the ID is issued. Mga Kinakailangan Barangay Certificate Birth Certificate of minor child/children under custody 1x1 picture Prosedura Register at the MSWDO and submit your requirements. Staff will check and verify your submitted documents. Submit your requirements and undergo assessment using the solo parent intake form. After 6 months of assessment, the Solo Parent ID is recorded in the logbook and issued. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 15 minutes (assessment) + 6 months before ID issuance Bayad: Free Saan Mag-aapply: MSWDO Office, Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1751 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Pwd Assistive Devices
body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon PWD Assistive Devices Mag-apply para sa mga assistive device mula sa MSWDO para sa mga PWD sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "PWD Assistive Devices", "description": "Nag-aalok ang MSWDO ng mga assistive device para sa mga Persons with Disabilities (PWD).", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides assistive devices such as crutches, wheelchairs, prosthesis, and other gadgets to Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) to help them integrate into the mainstream of community life. The service covers orthopedically handicapped, visually impaired, and immobile individuals aged 0–59 years old. The MSWDO coordinates with PSWDO and DSWD Field Office I for funding and procurement of devices. Mga Kinakailangan Barangay Certificate of Indigency Medical Certificate with doctor's recommendation for assistive device Whole body picture Prosedura Apply at the MSWDO. A family member may represent the client. Staff will interview and gather relevant information from the client or family member. Submit Barangay Certificate, Medical Certificate, and whole body picture. MSWDO conducts follow-up, home visit, and assesses eligibility and device needs. MSWDO prepares and submits documents to PSWDO/DSWD FO1 for funding and purchase. Receive the assistive device (crutches, wheelchair, prosthesis, etc.) upon availability. title: Osca Death Aid
body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon OSCA Death Aid Benefits Mag-apply para sa death aid benefit mula sa OSCA para sa pamilya ng namatay na senior citizen sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "OSCA Death Aid Benefits", "description": "Ang death aid ay ibinibigay sa pamilya ng namatay na senior citizen.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The OSCA Death Aid Benefits provide financial assistance to families of deceased Senior Citizens. The benefit is processed through the MSWDO upon submission of the deceased's original death certificate, two photocopies of the OSCA ID, and surrender of the OSCA ID. The MSWDO prepares the application and submits reports to the Municipal Budget Office for fund allocation. Mga Kinakailangan Certificate of Indigency Death Certificate (original copy) OSCA ID (original + two photocopies) Prosedura Register at the MSWDO. Staff will conduct intake interview and assess eligibility. Submit the deceased's original Death Certificate, two photocopies of OSCA ID, and surrender the OSCA ID. MSWDO prepares the Application Form and Certificate of Eligibility. MSWDO submits report with attached documents to the Municipal Budget Office for fund allocation. Follow up with the MSWDO for the status of financial assistance. Receive the OSCA financial assistance at the Municipal Treasury Office. body: Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon Social Case Study Report Humiling ng social case study report mula sa MSWDO para sa mga kaso ng child welfare at social welfare. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Social Case Study Report", "description": "Ang social case study report ay inihahanda ng MSWDO para sa mga kaso ng child welfare, domestic violence, at iba pang social welfare concerns.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A Social Case Study Report is issued to clients who need to avail of assistance from PCSO, other government hospitals, institutions, NGOs, DSWD, and various foundations. The report is prepared by MSWDO social workers after a thorough assessment that includes an initial interview, home visit, and evaluation of the client's situation. The report serves as a supporting document for various forms of assistance. Mga Kinakailangan Certificate of Indigency from Barangay Captain Medical Certificate / Clinical Abstract / Medico-Legal report Police report / Police blotter (if applicable) Whole body picture Birth Certificate (PSA/MCR) Psychiatric Evaluation Report (as needed) Prosedura Apply at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer you for initial interview. Discuss your problem and provide relevant information. Staff conducts initial interview and gathers data. title: Marriage Counseling
body: Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon Pre-Marriage Counseling Kumuha ng pre-marriage counseling mula sa MSWDO bago ang iyong kasal sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Pre-Marriage Counseling", "description": "Ang pre-marriage counseling ay ibinibigay ng MSWDO sa mga mag-asawa na magpapakasal.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides pre-marriage counseling to would-be couples as required before obtaining a marriage license. The counseling covers family planning, rights and responsibilities of marriage, and strengthening family solidarity. The service is mandated by law and the certificate issued is a prerequisite for marriage license application. Would-be couples, couples with marital problems, couples of reproductive age, and solo parents may avail of this service. Mga Kinakailangan Personal Data Form Marriage Counselling Services Form Prosedura Apply at the MSWDO. Staff will refer you to the Population Office. After the seminar, the Pre-Marriage Counseling Certificate is signed by the counselor. Receive the duly signed Pre-Marriage Counseling Certificate. title: Disaster Relief
body: Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon Tulong sa Disaster Relief Mag-apply para sa tulong sa disaster relief mula sa MDRRMO sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Tulong sa Disaster Relief", "description": "Nag-aalok ang MDRRMO ng mga serbisyo ng tulong sa disaster para sa mga apektadong residente.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides disaster relief assistance and rehabilitation services to families affected by floods, typhoons, fires, and other calamities. The service includes verification of affected families, distribution of relief goods through the Barangay Captain with the BDCC, and financial assistance (ESA) for families whose houses are totally destroyed. The MSWDO coordinates with the LGU, PSWDO, and DSWD Field Office I. Mga Kinakailangan Master list of affected families (from Barangay Captain) Barangay certificate Certificate of Indigency Prosedura Report to the Barangay Captain the extent of damage. The Captain validates and forwards the list to MSWDO. MSWDO attends MDDC meeting conducted by the Local Chief Executive. MSWDO receives list of affected families and endorses to concerned social worker. Verification and inspection team (with Engineering, PNP, DSWD) assesses the damage. MSWDO requests and lobbies for allocation of relief goods from LGU, PSWDO, DSWD FO1. Distribution of relief goods through the Barangay Captain with the BDCC. For totally destroyed houses, MSWDO prepares project proposal for ESA funding. Financial assistance (ESA) is distributed to qualified beneficiaries. MSWDO monitors and evaluates project implementation for house repair/reconstruction. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: Varies (1 day for relief goods, 1–3 weeks for financial assistance) Bayad: Free Saan Mag-aapply: MSWDO Office, Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1751 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Special Social Services
body: Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon Mga Espesyal na Serbisyong Panlipunan Mga espesyal na serbisyong panlipunan mula sa MSWDO sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Mga Espesyal na Serbisyong Panlipunan", "description": "Nag-aalok ang MSWDO ng mga espesyal na serbisyong panlipunan para sa mga nangangailangan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides special social services for mentally challenged clients and other individuals requiring specialized assistance. title: Pre Natal
body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan Pre-Natal Consultation Kumuha ng pre-natal na konsultasyon sa RHU sa Mapandan. Libre para sa lahat ng buntis. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Pre-Natal Consultation", "description": "Nag-aalok ang RHU ng mga pre-natal na konsultasyon para sa mga buntis na kababaihan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The RHU provides pre-natal consultation services for antenatal women. The service includes registration in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR), OB history, vital signs, Leopold's maneuver, fetal heartbeat assessment, and fundic height measurement. Routine laboratory tests (CBC, urinalysis, HBsAg, RPR) are requested. The MHO conducts complete physical examination, interprets laboratory results, and provides health teaching on proper nutrition, prenatal care, breastfeeding, and immunization. High-risk patients are referred to higher-level facilities. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Medical Records, Laboratory Results, Prescription for Medicines (from previous physician, if any) Prosedura Register in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Midwife encodes OB history, vital signs, and performs Leopold's maneuver. Request for routine laboratory tests (CBC, urinalysis, HBsAg Screening, RPR test). MHO performs complete physical examination and interprets laboratory results. If high-risk, patient is referred to a higher level of facility. Health teaching on proper nutrition, prenatal care, breastfeeding, and immunization. body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan TB DOTS Treatment Kumuha ng TB DOTS treatment sa RHU sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "TB DOTS Treatment", "description": "Nag-aalok ang RHU ng TB DOTS treatment para sa mga pasyenteng may tuberculosis.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The RHU provides Directly Observed Treatment Short Course (TB DOTS) for patients with tuberculosis. The service includes registration, sputum examination, GeneXpert/TBDC testing, physical examination, and provision of anti-TB drugs with proper intake instructions. The MHO maintains patient confidentiality and monitors treatment compliance. title: Laboratory
body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan Laboratory Examination Kumuha ng laboratory examination sa RHU sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Laboratory Examination", "description": "Nag-aalok ang RHU ng mga laboratory examination.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The RHU primary laboratory provides various diagnostic tests including ABO/RH typing, pregnancy test, CBC, urinalysis, fecalysis, Hepatitis B screening, and fasting blood sugar (FBS). The MHO provides a laboratory request, and the Medical Technologist conducts the examination. Results are interpreted by the MHO who prescribes medications as needed. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Physician's laboratory request / referral Prosedura Register in the log book. Midwife encodes data, vital signs, and asks about symptoms. MHO conducts physical examination and requests laboratory tests. Submit specimen for testing. Available tests: ABO/RH typing (₱100), Pregnancy test (₱50), CBC (₱150), Urinalysis (₱65), Fecalysis (₱65), Hepatitis B screening (₱200), FBS (₱100). Medical Technologist conducts the laboratory examination. MHO interprets laboratory results and prescribes medications. title: Nutrition Immunization
body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan Programang Nutrition at Immunization Mga programang nutrition at immunization mula sa RHU sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Programang Nutrition at Immunization", "description": "Nag-aalok ang RHU ng mga programang nutrition at immunization.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The RHU implements the Nutrition Program for malnourished children (0–59 months and older) and the National Immunization Program (NIP) for children against vaccine-preventable diseases. The nutrition program includes assessment, deworming, feeding with nutrient-dense food, and monthly monitoring. The immunization program administers age-appropriate vaccines after reviewing the child's records and checking vital signs. Mga Kinakailangan Birth Certificate (Municipal Civil Registry) Medical Records, Vaccination Records (from hospital of birth or pediatrician) Prosedura For malnourished children (0–59 months): Barangay Nutrition Scholar assesses weight and height. Physician refers to RHU for deworming and medical intervention. Child is fed with nutrient-dense food (high carbohydrate and protein). Monthly monitoring of weight, height, and alertness. For immunization: BHW interviews child's information and reviews records. Midwife checks vital signs (weight and temperature). Midwife administers age-appropriate vaccine. Midwife advises parent on child care and expected outcome. Schedule next vaccination. title: Electrical Zoning
body: Zoning at Planificación Electrical Zoning Clearance Kumuha ng electrical zoning clearance mula sa MPDC sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Electrical Zoning Clearance", "description": "Ang electrical zoning clearance ay kinakailangan para sa mga electrical installation.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Zoning at Planificación", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A zoning clearance is required for electrical permits. The MPDC/Zoning Office evaluates the application, conducts land use assessment, and issues the Zoning Compliance Certificate for electrical installations. The process includes site evaluation/inspection, computation of fees, and approval by the Zoning Officer. Mga Kinakailangan Application for Zoning Permit (from MPDC) Accomplished Individual Assessment for Application of Temporary Housing Unit Form Tax Declaration of lot (from Assessor Office) Current Tax receipts (from Treasury Office) Affidavit of consent of lot owner Site development sketch indicating the ROW Affidavit of consent for Right of Way (from lot owner) Certification from Barangay Captain Prosedura Inquire at the MPDC office and secure the application form. MPDC staff conducts interview and provides forms. Accomplish forms and prepare all required documents. MPDC checks and evaluates forms and required documents. Request for site evaluation/inspection. Land use assessment conducted. Go to Zoning office for computation of fees and charges. Pay fees at the Treasury Office. Present receipts to MPDC. Submit one photocopy of all forms and documents. MPDC prepares and submits documents. Zoning Officer approves application. Client signs logbook. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Planning and Development Office (MPDC) / Zoning Office Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: ~1.5 hours Bayad: ₱330 (Zoning fee ₱200 + Affidavit ₱100 + Documentary Stamp ₱30) Saan Mag-aapply: MPDC / Zoning Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: 0933-865-9150 / 0925-708-8808 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. body: Civil Registry at mga Vital Record Rehistrasyon ng Kapanganakan Mag-rehistro ng kapanganakan sa MCR sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Rehistrasyon ng Kapanganakan", "description": "Rehistrasyon ng kapanganakan sa Municipal Civil Registrar.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Civil Registry at mga Vital Record", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Registration of birth at the Municipal Civil Registrar. Covers three pathways: (1) Attending midwife/hilot reports child's birth — requires Marriage Certificate of parents and Mun. Form 102; (2) Unmarried parents — requires Community Tax Certificate; (3) Hospital administrator — requires Accomplished Mun. Form 102. Late registration requires negative PSA certification and supporting documents. Fees: Misc Fee ₱115 (standard), ₱215 (unmarried), ₱100 (hospital), ₱315–₱1,015 (late registration depending on age). Mga Kinakailangan Marriage Certificate of parents from PSA (for attending midwife/hilot registration) Community Tax Certificate from Treasury Office (for unmarried parents) Accomplished Mun. Form 102 from MCR (for hospital registration) Negative certification from PSA (for late registration) Affidavit of delayed registration (for late registration) Supporting evidence: Baptismal Certificate, School records, ITR, Insurance Policy, Medical records, Barangay certification (for late registration) Prosedura Attending midwife/hilot reports child's birth. MCR evaluates information and registers (10 min). For unmarried parents: Hospital admin or representative prepares documents (15 min). For late registration: Apply at MCR, verify from CRIS/Registry Book. If negative, submit requirements. Data typed in Certificate of Live Birth (15 min typing). MCR approves registration (after 10 days of posting for late registration). Secure copy of birth certificate. MCR releases documents (3 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 10 minutes (standard) to 10 days (late registration posting) Bayad: ₱115 (standard) / ₱215 (unmarried) / ₱100 (hospital) / ₱315–₱1,015 (late registration) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Civil Registrar's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 633-2487 / 0912-115-5000 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. Tax maps are required for property transactions, land use planning, and other legal purposes. The client submits a written request with the lot details, and the Assessor's Office prepares the tax map from their records. Mga Kinakailangan Written request specifying the lot number, block, street, and barangay Valid Government-issued ID Prosedura Submit a written request with lot details and valid ID to the Assessor's Office. Staff receives and verifies the request (3 min). Staff locates the tax map in the records (7 min). Staff prepares and issues the tax map (3 min). Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office and claim the tax map (2 min). title: Assessor Inquiries
body: Real Property at Revenue Mga Inquiries at Verifications Mag-inquire o mag-verify ng impormasyon sa Assessor's Office sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Mga Inquiries at Verifications", "description": "Mga inquiries at verification tungkol sa mga ari-arian.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Municipal Assessor's Office provides information and verification services regarding real property records, assessed values, tax declarations, and other property-related inquiries. The client may inquire about the status of their property, verify assessed values, check for outstanding obligations, or request general information about property taxation. The Assessor's Office staff provides the information from their records. Mga Kinakailangan Valid Government-issued ID Property details (lot number, block, street, barangay) if inquiring about a specific property Prosedura Visit the Assessor's Office and present your valid ID. State your inquiry or verification request to the staff. Staff looks up the information in the records (10 min). Staff provides the information or prints the verification document (3 min). Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office if a printed document is required (2 min). title: Assessor Annotations
body: Real Property at Revenue Recording at Cancellation ng Mga Annotation Mag-file ng recording o cancellation ng annotation sa Assessor's Office sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Recording at Cancellation ng Mga Annotation", "description": "Recording at cancellation ng mga annotation sa Tax Declaration.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Municipal Assessor's Office records new annotations or cancels existing annotations on Tax Declarations. Annotations include mortgages, liens, legal inhibitions, court orders, and other encumbrances affecting the property. The client submits the supporting documents (e.g., Deed of Mortgage, Release of Mortgage, Court Order), and the Assessor's Office updates the Tax Declaration accordingly. Mga Kinakailangan Deed of Mortgage / Release of Mortgage (for mortgage annotations) Court Order or Writ of Attachment (for legal annotations) Valid Government-issued ID of the property owner Current Tax Declaration Prosedura Submit the supporting documents and valid ID to the Assessor's Office. Staff receives and reviews the documents (5 min). Staff verifies the authenticity and completeness of the documents (5 min). Staff records the annotation or cancellation on the Tax Declaration (5 min). Pay ₱150 at the Treasury Office and claim the updated Tax Declaration (5 min). The client submits a complaint with supporting evidence, and the MENRO investigates, verifies the complaint, and takes appropriate enforcement action. The MENRO coordinates with the PNP, Barangay officials, and other agencies as needed. Mga Kinakailangan Written complaint describing the environmental violation Evidence of violation (photos, videos, or other documentation if available) Valid Government-issued ID of the complainant Prosedura Submit the written complaint with evidence and valid ID to the MENRO Office. MENRO takes appropriate enforcement action and coordinates with concerned agencies. Follow up with MENRO for the status of the complaint. The session covers family planning methods, reproductive health, responsible parenthood, and RA 9255. title: Philhealth Enrollment
body: Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon LGU PhilHealth Group Enrollment Mag-enroll sa PhilHealth group enrollment sa MSWDO sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "LGU PhilHealth Group Enrollment", "description": "Group enrollment sa PhilHealth sa pamamagitan ng LGU.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Population Office facilitates group enrollment of indigent residents to PhilHealth under the Local Government Unit (LGU)-sponsored program. The LGU subsidizes the premium contributions of qualified beneficiaries. Enrolled members receive health insurance coverage for hospitalization and medical services at PhilHealth-accredited facilities. The Population Office verifies eligibility, collects required documents, and submits the enrollment to PhilHealth. Mga Kinakailangan Valid Government-issued ID Certificate of Indigency from the Barangay Captain Birth Certificate or any valid ID showing date of birth Prosedura Visit the Population Office and submit the required documents. Staff verifies eligibility and reviews the documents (3 min). Staff fills out the PhilHealth enrollment form (3 min). Staff submits the enrollment to PhilHealth for validation (2 min). Receive confirmation of enrollment. PhilHealth ID will be distributed upon availability (2 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Population Office Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 10 minutes (processing); enrollment effective upon PhilHealth validation Bayad: Free (LGU-subsidized) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Population Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Legislative
body: Sangguniang Bayan Legislative Documents A comprehensive database of municipal ordinances, resolutions, executive issuances, and fiscal data — tracing Mapandan's legislative record from its 1887 founding to the present. Framework Lokal na pamamahala at mga pinagmulan ng batas Legal Basis Ang Bayan ng Mapandan ay gumagana sa ilalim ng Republic Act Blg. 7160 (Local Government Code ng 1991), matatagpuan sa Ikatlong Kongresonal na Distrito ng Pangasinan. Ang Sangguniang Bayan — isang unicameral na lokal na lehislatibong konseho — ang nagsasagawa ng municipal legislative power, pinamumunuan ng Municipal Vice Mayor at binubuo ng mga halal na konsehal kasama ang mga ex-officio representatives mula sa Liga ng mga Barangay at Sangguniang Kabataan Federation. Mga Pinagmulan ng Kasaysayan Originally an agricultural barrio of Mangaldan referred to as balon baley ("new town"), Mapandan was first established as an independent pueblo pursuant to Direction General No. 39, Administration Civil No. 169-C, promulgated by Governor General Emilio Bravo on December 28, 1887. Following population and fiscal losses caused by an epidemic in 1905 that temporarily reverted Mapandan to Mangaldan's jurisdiction, the municipality was re-established under American civil administration through Executive Order No. 10, signed by Governor General James F. Smith in 1909. No. 5, S-2024 Pipeline Legislative pipeline The legislative pipeline under the Local Government Code of 1991. 1 Filing A proposed ordinance is filed with the Sangguniang Bayan for consideration. 2 First Reading Initial reading and referral to the relevant committee for review. 3 Committee Hearing The committee holds hearings and deliberates on the proposal. 4 Committee Report Findings and recommendations are submitted back to the full council. 5 Second Reading Detailed floor discussion and debate on the proposed ordinance. 6 Third & Final Reading Final vote by the Sangguniang Bayan. 7 Mayor's Approval The Municipal Mayor reviews and approves the enacted ordinance. 8 Provincial Review Submitted to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Pangasinan for legal review under Sections 56 and 57 of R.A. 7160. 9 Posting & Effect The approved ordinance is posted publicly and takes effect across all 15 constituent barangays. Key Distinction Ordinance vs. Resolution Under the Local Government Code of 1991, the Sangguniang Bayan enacts two types of legislative measures: Ordinance A legislative measure that enacts a permanent rule or policy . Ordinances carry the force of law, create offices, levy taxes, or regulate conduct. They require three readings, publication, and the Mayor's approval (or passage by 2/3 override of a veto). Resolution A legislative measure that expresses the sentiment, intent, or opinion of the Sangguniang Bayan on a specific matter. Resolutions are used for internal housekeeping, requesting national action, or authorizing one-time transactions. They require only one reading and are not subject to publication.
